31400.meaning1: (of a door or window) closing; shutting

examples.text: sā'pi kho brāhmaṇī tassa brāhmaṇassa piṭṭhito pāvisi. atha kho āyasmā udāyī ekacce vātapāne vivaranto ekacce vātapāne thakento gabbhaṃ anuparigantvā piṭṭhito āgantvā tassā brāhmaṇiyā aṅgam'aṅgāni parāmasi.
taṃ sutvā gāmikā visaṃ nāma kakkhaḷaṃ, yo naṃ khādati, so marati, kaṇṭakam'pi vijjhitvā māreti, ubho'p'ete kakkhaḷā, ko ettha ānisaṃso'ti gehadvārāni thakesuṃ, dārake ca palāpesuṃ.
sara catur'odadhī, upanīte assuthaññarudhiramhi, sara ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena samaṃ.

examples.text: na naggacariyā na jaṭā na paṅkā, n'ānāsakā thaṇḍilasāyikā vā, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ, sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ.

31418.commentary: (THIa) sobhate su thanakā pure mamā'ti mama ubho'pi thanā yathāvuttarūpā hutvā suvaṇṇakalasiyo viya sobhiṃsu. puthutte hi idaṃ ekavacanaṃ, atīt'atthe ca vattamānavacanaṃ.

examples.text: pīnavaṭṭasahit'uggatā ubho, sobhare su thanakā pure mama, thevikī'va lambanti n'odakā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
yattha bheravā sarīsapā, vijju sañcarati thanayati devo, andhakāratimisāya rattiyā, nisīdi tattha bhikkhu vigatalomahaṃso.

31423.commentary: (DNa) thanayaṃ āga pajjunno'ti pajjunno ca devarājā thanayanto āgato. (ANa) thanayan'ti gajjanto.

examples.text: sadāmattā hāragajā, missakā ca yasassino, thanayaṃ āga pajjunno, yo disā abhivassati.
yathā'pi megho thanayaṃ, vijjumālī satakkaku, thalaṃ ninnañ'ca pūreti, abhivassaṃ vasun'dharaṃ.
nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosatthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
atītayobbano poso, āneti timbarutthaniṃ, tassā issā na supati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī asaṅkaccikā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. tassā rathikāya vātamaṇḍalikā saṅghāṭiyo ukkhipiṃsu. manussā ukkuṭṭhiṃ akaṃsu, sundarā ayyāya than'udarā'ti.

31429.commentary: (DNa) ogāhe te thanūdaran'ti yathā so nāgo pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhitvā pivitvā aggasoṇḍamattaṃ paññāyamānaṃ katvā nimuggo sukhaṃ sātaṃ vindati, evaṃ kadā nu kho te than'ūdaraṃ thanavemajjhaṃ udarañ'ca otaritvā ahaṃ sukhaṃ sātaṃ paṭilabhissāmī'ti vadati.

examples.text: sīt'odakaṃ pokkharaṇiṃ, yuttaṃ kiñjakkhareṇunā, nāgo ghamm'ābhitatto'va, ogāhe te than'ūdaraṃ.

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi. addasā kho uttaro māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsa-mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yebhuyyena thapetvā dve.

31439.meaning2: clump of grass, tuft of grass

31440.commentary: (DNa) bīraṇatthambake'ti bīraṇatiṇatthambo tasmiṃ susāne atthi, tasmā taṃ bīraṇatthambakan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: kālaṅ'kato ca kālakañcikā nāma asurā sabbanihīno asurakāyo, tatra upapajjissati. kālaṅ'katañ'ca naṃ bīraṇatthambake susāne chaḍḍessanti.
ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibandheyya. atha kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ.
thambhassa ca pahānāya sārambhassa ca pahānāya, atthi majjhimā paṭipadā cakkhukaraṇī ñāṇakaraṇī upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati

31446.meaning1: stiffening with fear; being paralysed with terror

examples.text: dhammassa, ānanda, pāsādassa caturāsīti thambhasahassāni ahesuṃ catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ, eko thambho sovaṇṇamayo, eko rūpiyamayo, eko veḷuriyamayo, eko phalikamayo.

31449.meaning2: establishes, supports; makes stiff or rigid

examples.text: ahosiṃ ahaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro.

31452.meaning2: hilt of sword; handle of a weapon

31453.meaning1: dry land; firm ground; terra firma

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? anusotagāmī puggalo, paṭisotagāmī puggalo, ṭhit'atto puggalo, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
vārijo'va thale khitto, okam'okata'ubbhato, pariphandat'idaṃ cittaṃ, māradheyyaṃ pahātave.
gāme vā yadi v'āraññe, ninne vā yadi vā thale, yattha arahanto viharanti, taṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ.
yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā, vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ saṃpatāmi.

31456.meaning1: born on the land; growing on land; terrestrial

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇirāmaṇeyyakaṃ, atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye thalajā, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye odakā.

mahāsamudde'pi samantā yojanaṃ vīciyo vūpasantā, pañca vaṇṇāni padumāni pupphitāni, antalikkhe dibbāni tūriyāni pavajjiṃsu, ākāse jalaja-thalaja-rukkh'ādi-sannissitāhi devatāhi pavattitā ativiya uḷārā pūjā ahosi.

examples.text: āpadāsu kho, mahārāja, thāmo veditabbo. so ca kho dīghena addhunā na ittaraṃ, manasikarotā no amanasikarotā, paññavatā no duppaññena

31482.meaning2: water used for washing a pot

31484.meaning1: one hundred bowls of food; one hundred dishes
31484.commentary: (SNa) tattha eko thālipāko dasannaṃ purisānaṃ bhattaṃ gaṇhāti

examples.text: atha kho te licchavī tassā rattiyā accayena saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa pañcamattāni thālipākasatāni bhatt'ābhihāraṃ abhihariṃsu.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā thālipākasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so thālipāko hoti yato nāḷik'odanaparamaṃ bhuñjāmi tadupiyañ'ca sūpeyyaṃ.

31486.meaning1: stationary; stable; immobile; arahant; (comm) without craving
31486.commentary: (MNa) tasā vuccanti sataṇhā, thāvarā nittaṇhā. (KHPa) tasantī'ti tasā, sataṇhānaṃ sabhayānañ'c'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tiṭṭhantī'ti thāvarā, pahīnataṇh'ābhayānaṃ arahataṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: nidhāya daṇḍaṃ bhūtesu, tasesu thāvaresu ca, yo na hanti na ghāteti, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
ye keci pāṇabhūt'atthi, tasā vā thāvarā vā anavasesā, dīghā vā y'eva mahantā vā, majjhimā rassakā aṇukathūlā.

31487.commentary: (DNa) janapadatthāvariyappatto'ti janapade dhuvabhāvaṃ thāvarabhāvaṃ patto, na sakkā kenaci cāletuṃ. janapado vā tamhi thāvariyappatto anuyutto sakammanirato acalo asampavedhī'ti janapadatthāvariyappatto.

examples.text: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti

31489.meaning2: stability; continuance; being firm, long lasting

examples.text: yo uddhatena cittena, samphañ'ca bahu bhāsati, asamāhitasaṅkappo, asaddhammarato mago, ārā so thāvareyyamhā, pāpadiṭṭhi anādaro.

31490.commentary: (ANa) thinaṃ cittagelaññaṃ, middhaṃ cetasikagelaññaṃ. thinañ'ca middhañ'ca thinamiddhaṃ.

examples.text: pahānaṃ kāmacchandānaṃ, domanassāna c'ūbhayaṃ, thinassa ca panūdanaṃ, kukkuccānaṃ nivāraṇaṃ.
thinamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathinamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thinamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti

31493.meaning1: dullness and drowsiness; sloth and torpor; rigidity and lethargy

examples.text: kāmacchando ca byāpādo, thinamiddhañ'ca bhikkhuno, uddhaccaṃ vicikicchā ca, pañc'ete cittakelisā.
santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhan'ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhaṃ, n'atthi me ajjhattaṃ thinamiddhan'ti pajānāti

31494.meaning1: serving as a basis for dullness and drowsiness; giving support to sloth and torpor

examples.text: thinamiddhaṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannañ'c'eva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañ'ca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāyaṃ saṃvattati.

31495.meaning1: obstacle that is dullness and drowsiness; hindrance of sloth and torpor
31495.meaning2: obstacle of dullness and drowsiness; hindrance of sloth and torpor

examples.text: kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ.

31496.meaning1: obsessed by dullness and drowsiness; consumed by sloth and torpor
31496.commentary: (MNa) thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitā'ti cittagelaññabhūtena thinena sesanāmakāyagelaññabhūtena middhena ca pariyuṭṭhitā, abhibhūtā gahitā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. te niddābahulā honti.

examples.text: thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati thinamiddhaparetena uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so thinamiddhaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

31497.meaning1: afflicted with dullness and drowsiness; overcome by sloth and torpor

examples.text: thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati thinamiddhaparetena uppannassa ca thinamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so thinamiddhaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

31498.meaning1: closely associated with dullness and drowsiness

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando thinamiddhasahagato thinamiddhasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto chando.

31499.commentary: (SNa) thinamiddhasahagato'ti idha bhikkhu chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto nisīdati. ath'assa thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati. so uppannaṃ me thinamiddhan'ti ñatvā udakena mukhaṃ puñchitvā, kaṇṇe ākaḍḍhitvā paguṇaṃ dhammaṃ sajjhāyitvā divā gahitaṃ vā ālokasaññaṃ manasikaritvā thinamiddhaṃ vinodetvā puna chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karoti. ath'assa puna thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando thinamiddhasahagato thinamiddhasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto chando.
